text: The Hermes reference project is NousResearch/hermes-agent (MIT), a personal agent harness not an enterprise RAG/SSO platform.
Self-hosted RAG landscape splits into platforms with UI+connectors, chat UIs with light RAG, and assemble-yourself frameworks.
Onyx Community Edition is MIT for core chat/RAG/agents; document RBAC and source permission mirroring are Enterprise Edition.
Dify OSS license is Apache-2.0 with additional conditions barring unauthorized multi-tenant SaaS; SSO/multi-workspace are Enterprise.
LibreChat supports multi-provider models, Agents/MCP, and SAML or OIDC (not both at once); MIT licensed.
Open WebUI community edition documents SSO/OIDC, LDAP, SCIM 2.0, and RBAC; weaker than Onyx EE on source-permission inheritance.
LibreChat and Open WebUI are chat-first with light file RAG; not enterprise-search connector platforms.
RAGFlow is an Apache-2.0 self-hosted RAG engine with rising connector sync (0.22) and higher RAM floor (~16GB).
AnythingLLM enterprise SSO is Simple SSO passthrough, not native OIDC/SAML productization.
Onyx Lite is a lighter chat-only mode; Standard Onyx adds OpenSearch, workers, Redis, MinIO for full RAG.
